instruction: Use command-line automation with the installed SOLIDWORKS CAM 2025 environment (powered by CAMWorks); do not use GUI clicks, generic G-code generators, or manual .nc editing/copying. For this task, SOLIDWORKS CAM/CAMWorks is hosted by `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\SLDWORKS.exe`; run the native CAM automation through that installation. Load C:\Users\User\Desktop\basic_milling_part.step and read C:\Users\User\Desktop\tools.csv. Use one top-side 3-axis milling setup and G54 at the model top-face center [0, 0, 6] mm. In the posted work coordinates, the top face is Z=0 and positive Z points away from the material. Machine the 48 x 24 mm central pocket to Z=-3 with T1 (D8 flat end mill, S7800, F480), drill exactly the two visible holes centered at X=-12/Y=0 and X=12/Y=0 through the 12 mm stock with T2 (D5 drill, S5000, F180), and finish the complete 72 x 48 mm outside Profile/Contour to Z=-12 with T3 last (D6 profile end mill, S8500, F600). Use a conventional three-axis milling post with explicit units, G54, tool length compensation, safe rapid clearance, and program termination. Do not use Mill-Turn, turning, live tooling, C-axis, Y-axis turning, indexed 4/5-axis, or simultaneous 5-axis machining. Save the posted NC output exactly as C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-18.nc.
